help.correspondence: Incoming and outgoing official letters, reply chains, registered e-mail (KEP) and e-mail.
help.submittals: Submittal items, packages and the submittal register.
help.issues: Issues raised on site and in the model.
help.forms: Site forms, checklists and form templates.
help.coordination: Model sets, clash tests and information requirements checks (IDS).
help.spec: Draft submittal register from a specification PDF.
help.reports: Report dashboards and ready-made report templates.

modules.description: A module that is turned off does not appear in the menu, the Work views, the "+ New" window, the Model tabs, the Ask assistant or reports. Its data is not deleted: existing records still open, only new records cannot be created. Documents are always on.

add.heading: Add Member
add.hint: People not in the list are created by the system administrator in Administration.

naming.description: Link a standard to a folder in Documents → Folder settings. File names are checked on upload in the linked folder and its subfolders.

fields.fields: Fields — one field per line: "Name | list | CODE=Description, CODE2" · "Name | number | 4" (or "2-3") · "Name | text" · add "| meta" at the end for a field that is not part of the name

editor.defaultFields:
Project | list | PRJ
Company | list | ABC, XYZ
Discipline | list | A, S, M, E
Type | list | M3, DR
Number | number | 4

templateExport.heading: Export as Template
templateExport.description: This project's structure is written to a single JSON file: folders (with their states and sub-states, including “on first file” folders not created yet), folder permissions by company role, naming standards, attributes and approval workflows. Files, records and people are not included. Use it with the “From a JSON File” option when creating a new project.

remove.title: Delete Role
remove.confirm: Delete the role "{{name}}"? The role's folder permissions are removed too.

roles.description: Every project has Viewer, Editor and Administrator ready (permission on all folders from the root). Choose one when adding a member; extra teams (+ Role) are also used in folder permissions and approval steps.

rolePackage.title: Apply Role Package to Company
rolePackage.description: The package writes company permissions to folders with an ISO 19650 state (Work in Progress / Shared / Published / Archived). Existing permissions are not lowered or deleted; a subfolder never gets a permission lower than the one inherited from above. Preview first, then apply.

options.hasOwnArea: Company Has Its Own Area (e.g. 01-WIP / 99-Tasarımcı Ortak Alan)

rolePackage.noMembers: This company has no members in the project; the permissions reach no one for now.
rolePackage.empty: The project has no folders with an ISO 19650 state. Assign states in folder settings.

remove.title: Delete Attribute
remove.confirm: Delete the attribute "{{name}}"? Values on files remain as free attributes.

attributes.description: Link attributes to a folder in Documents → Folder settings. In the linked folder and its subfolders they appear as table columns and are asked for on upload; required ones cannot be left empty.

options.required: Required (cannot be left empty when uploading to linked folders)

editor.renameNotice: When the name changes, this attribute's key on the project's files is updated to the new name too.

personal.heading: My Own API Keys
personal.description: Keys are encrypted on the server with AES-256-GCM; they are never shown in clear text in the interface or in API responses. Hashing is not used, because a key that must be sent to the provider again cannot be recovered from a hash.
personal.notAllowed: You can save your key and test the connection. To use it with project data: {{reason}}
personal.replacePlaceholder: {{masked}} · type a new one to replace it
personal.workspaceHelp: Needed when your key can act on more than one Workspace; sent as anthropic-workspace-id with every request. Find it in Anthropic Console → Workspaces.
personal.modelsHelp: The list is loaded from Anthropic: the models your key can use.

workTypes.heading: Work Types
workTypes.tokensHint: Pattern fields: {{tokens}}. The sequence number increases among records whose pattern is otherwise identical (e.g. separately for each sender/recipient/year).

editor.dueDaysHint: When submitted for approval, the due date becomes today + this many days. Without a workflow, the action company answers in a single step.

options.incoming: Incoming Record (not sent, recorded as received)

automation.heading: Automatic Transmittal When a Review Completes
automation.description: When a review started with the selected review template finishes, the approved files (their approved copies, if any) are added to a transmittal, a cover sheet is generated and it is sent to the recipient companies within the CDE. If no recipient is selected, it goes to the company that started the review.
automation.empty: No review templates. Add one in the "Workflows" tab.

numbering.applied: {{preset}} applied. New numbers are given with this pattern.
numbering.heading: RFI and Submittal Numbers
numbering.hint: Standard: {{standard}} · ZAVM: {{zavm}}. The counter runs separately per discipline; {Konu} is not part of the counter.

remove.title: Delete Location
remove.confirm: Delete "{{name}}" and the locations under it?

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Stations, zones, levels, rooms or line / tunnel sections with km ranges. Issues, forms and files are linked to a location; filters include sub-locations too.
locations.empty: No locations yet. Add them by hand, import a CSV or create them from an IFC model's spatial structure.

detail.noLinks: No linked issues, forms or files.

csv.title: Import Locations from CSV
csv.description: A header row is required. Columns: Kod, Ad, Tip, Üst kod, Km başlangıç, Km bitiş, Sıra (delimiter ; , or tab). Locations with the same code are updated. If any row has an error, no record changes.

fields.parent: Rows with an empty parent code are added under

ifc.title: Create Locations from IFC
ifc.description: The model's spatial structure (Site → Building → Storey → Space, facilities and parts in IFC 4.3) is transferred to the location tree. Importing the same model again updates the names and does not create duplicates.

remove.title: Delete Template
remove.confirm: Delete the template "{{name}}"? Reviews in progress are not affected.

workflows.description: Approval workflow templates are chosen when a review is started. A started review runs with the template as it was at that moment; later changes apply only to new reviews.

fields.copyFolder: Folder to Copy Approved Files To

editor.stagesHint: Optional. Steps are tied to party stages (Designer → Contractor → Consultant → Client). A stage's time runs from its first step; in a "return" stage, a file that gets revise/reject leaves the chain and goes back to the initiator.
editor.namePatternHint: {Proje}, {Yıl}, {Ay} and file fields (attribute or naming field) can be used; {0000} is the counter. The counter is unique per project and prefix.
editor.copyFolderNotSet: Not selected (chosen when the review is started)

options.copyToBase: Copy a File with Missing Fields to the Target Folder Itself (otherwise it is not copied and is reported)

editor.finalHeading: Last Step's Outcome → File's Approval Status
editor.finalHint: Default: the same code. Files with "Approved" and "Approved with Comments" status are copied to the target folder.

step.heading: Step {{n}}

fields.name: Step Name
fields.requiredAttributes: Required Attributes in This Step (comma-separated; written to the file)

step.assigneesHint: When a company or team is assigned, one of its members answers with their own account; the record shows the person and "on behalf of …" together. No shared account is needed.

options.byAttribute: Also Assign by File Field (one template for all disciplines)

rule.attributeHint: Attribute or naming field name. The files in one review must fall to the same assignees.
